questions.stem: Chef sheet: planes 3x+3y+3z=6 and x+y+z=2 are?

options.text: The same plane, since the second is one-third of the first

questions.explanation: Second equation is one-third of first, same plane. B misses scaling; C/D are wrong.
questions.hint: Check if equations are scalar multiples.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_II
questions.topic: Line as the intersection of two planes
questions.learningObjective: Find direction vector of line from two normals
questions.stem: Chef sheet: planes with normals <1,0,0> and <0,1,0>; line direction is cross product; x-component?
questions.explanation: n1×n2 = <0,0,1>, x-component 0. A slip returns 1 from first normal.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_II
questions.topic: Unit tangent vector to a space curve
questions.learningObjective: Compute unit tangent at a point
questions.stem: Chef sheet: r(t)=<cos t, sin t, 0>, t=0; r'=<0,1,0>; unit tangent x-component?
questions.explanation: |r'|=1, T=<0,1,0>, x-component 0. A slip uses cos 0 = 1 for x.
